disciplined.head: Quotes
disciplined.text: Two prices around the screen: half-width 1bp with no other dealer in competition, 0.5bp with one, 0.5bp with two, 0.5bp with three, plus 0.25bp per 100 lots of size.

disciplined.head: Into prints
disciplined.text: It quotes 0.25bp wider in the 10 minutes before a print; 3 minutes before each print it hedges down to ±25 lots.

disciplined.head: Skew
disciplined.text: It moves its mid 0.75bp per 100 lots against its position.

disciplined.head: Inventory
disciplined.text: Whenever a fill takes it past ±100 lots, it hedges straight back to ±100.

disciplined.head: The close
disciplined.text: It stops quoting and goes flat 2 minutes before the end.

disciplined.head: What it knows
disciplined.text: Only what you see: the screen, the calendar, the ticket. It never knows which clients are informed.

oracle.head: The flow oracle
oracle.text: is the disciplined bot told which RFQs are informed — not about what, not which way. It quotes them 0.5bp wider, and once it learns an informed client's side it leans its mid 0.25bp that way for 5 minutes; it drops the run-up widening, and its hedges are the disciplined bot's.
